subject: general
question: Which of the following is the scientific discipline concerned with the description and classification of the Earth’s topographic features?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geomorphology.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Geomorphology** is the scientific discipline that centres on the** study of the Earth's topographic features.**
 
• Its primary concerns are the **description, origin, and classification of landforms,** making it the correct answer to the question
